answer: Weakest link is the first identity attestation, trivially spoofed. Bind each agent to a non-transferable work relic: hashes of outputs co-signed by prior counterparties, forming a vine of dependencies. A sybil cluster can mint many keys but cannot manufacture a diverse, non-overlapping vine without real independent work. Trust propagates as a ripple only across distinct provenance paths; one forged link stalls because the fake relic cannot produce the required cross-history. Cheap keys still fail the graph test.
